titleByLocale.it: Esperto di esperienza sul posto di lavoro IT
titleByLocale.fr: Expert en informatique en milieu de travail

descriptionByLocale.it:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality. The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here . Here's what we're looking for: We’re seeking an innovative and proactive IT Workplace Experience Expert who can empower employees with the tools, resources, and knowledge they need to do their jobs effectively and reach their full potential. You continuously evaluate and improve the employee experience through subject matter expertise in the digital workplace, focusing on efficiency, employee satisfaction and ensuring business continuity. This is a varied role and can give you a springboard into other careers in Informatics and beyond. Within this position you will frequently travel between our 2 affiliates in Vienna. Your upcoming mission:
• Providing technical consultancy for enterprise and business applications to business colleagues
• Adoption and Training to foster digital enablement
• Providing consultancy for specific groups and work with them how to leverage the existing tool for their benefit
• Proactively approaching business functions to understand their processes and suggest methods to increase productivity
• Increasing the adoption of IT services and solutions by promoting the use and features of IT services to connect end users with the appropriate tool for the job.
• Embracing agility through process automation and increased focus on stakeholder management and digital employee experience
• Keeping track of what changes are coming in the enterprise platforms and solutions and analyzing how it can affect employee productivity
• Automating business processes based on analysis and consultancy with business representatives
• Act as a digital enabler for our business colleagues & functions
• Act as the owner of the digital employee experience for the respective site
• Drive employee productivity through consultancy, provide intimacy and site proximity at the sites, and ensure a personalized Roche employee experience.
• Leverage available data (e.g.: Nexthink, SNOW) for proactive support
• Support and manage the Incident/ Request management processes to ensure SLA's are met and drive continuous improvement through trend analysis.
• Manage IT hardware lifecycle management & deskside support processes/managed services for the site
• Provide support & guidance for onsite services (e.g. events and meetings) by leveraging from internal and external providers. Drive the user experience and promote best practice.
• Drive and enable standard workplace infrastructure, global/local projects and deployments in collaboration with product teams.
• Proactively address and follow through on process-improvement ideas
• Support & drive budgeting process related to the respective site
• Support local audit, inspection and certification requirements
• Support local Business Continuity and IT Disaster Recovery planning activities
• Partner with our internal and external service providers Essential skills for your mission:
• Manage risks progressively and in a way that leads to opportunity
• Lean-Agile & Enterprise mindset that can break down silos. Focus on delivery through collaboration, and bringing people together to work towards the same purpose across organizational boundaries
• Intellectual curiosity and integrity and has a strong passion for innovation
• Understanding of Roche-supported operating systems, devices and applications, including the Google Suite of Applications
• Experience with ticketing systems and troubleshooting hardwar
